203	class CallInfo(object):
204	    """ Result/Exception info a function invocation. """
205	
206	    _result = attr.ib()
207	    # Optional[ExceptionInfo]
208	    excinfo = attr.ib()
209	    start = attr.ib()
210	    stop = attr.ib()
211	    when = attr.ib()
212	
213	    @property
214	    def result(self):
215	        if self.excinfo is not None:
216	            raise AttributeError("{!r} has no valid result".format(self))
217	        return self._result

219	    @classmethod
220	    def from_call(cls, func, when, reraise=None):
221	        #: context of invocation: one of "setup", "call",
222	        #: "teardown", "memocollect"
223	        start = time()
224	        excinfo = None
225	        try:
226	            result = func()
227	        except:  # noqa
228	            excinfo = ExceptionInfo.from_current()
229	            if reraise is not None and excinfo.errisinstance(reraise):
230	                raise
231	            result = None
232	        stop = time()
233	        return cls(start=start, stop=stop, when=when, result=result, excinfo=excinfo)

235	    def __repr__(self):
236	        if self.excinfo is not None:
237	            status = "exception"
238	            value = self.excinfo.value
239	        else:
240	            # TODO: investigate unification
241	            value = repr(self._result)
242	            status = "result"
243	        return "<CallInfo when={when!r} {status}: {value}>".format(
244	            when=self.when, value=value, status=status
245	        )
